from pathlib import Path

src = Path('/inputs/README.md')
out = Path('/work/README.md')
prefix = src.read_bytes()
assert prefix.endswith(b'\n')
prefix.decode('utf-8')

files = sorted((p for p in Path('/inputs').glob('*-*.md') if p.is_file()), key=lambda p: p.name)
rows = []
for p in files:
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    title = next((line[2:].strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('# ')), None)
    if title is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No level-one heading in {p}')
    rows.append(f'| [{p.name}](../inputs/{p.name}) | .md | {title} |')

suffix = ('\n## Reference index\n\n'
          '| File | Type | Description |\n'
          '| --- | --- | --- |\n'
          + '\n'.join(rows) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
out.write_bytes(prefix + suffix)

# Check exact output and protected input integrity relative to the captured prefix.
actual = out.read_bytes()
assert actual == prefix + suffix
assert actual[:len(prefix)] == prefix
assert actual.endswith((rows[-1] + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
assert len(files) == 4
assert [p.name for p in files] == ['experiment-patterns.md', 'notebook-structure.md', 'quality-checklist.md', 'tutorial-patterns.md']
assert src.read_bytes() == prefix
print(f'Wrote and verified {out}: {len(actual)} bytes, {len(rows)} rows')
